# XEVQOR

> Zero-knowledge, 100% client-side cryptographic and digital forensics Progressive Web App (PWA) suite hosted at https://xevqor.org. Every cryptographic, steganographic, and binary sanitization operation runs locally inside browser memory with strict CSP Level 3 SHA-256 script hashes and `connect-src 'none'` network isolation.

## Core Security Invariants
- **Zero Backend & Zero Telemetry**: Enforced via HTTP Content-Security-Policy (`connect-src 'none'`, `default-src 'none'`, `frame-ancestors 'none'`). No user inputs, files, or keys ever leave the device.
- **Offline-First PWA**: Pre-cached via Service Worker (`sw.js`) for air-gapped and offline browser execution.
- **Deterministic Release Integrity**: Every static asset is published with deterministic byte-order checksums in `https://xevqor.org/SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Suite Modules (10 Active Tools)
- [XEVQOR // KEYPASS](https://xevqor.org/keypass/): Stateless, zero-backend deterministic password and cryptographic key generator running 100% in browser memory with Web Crypto API and strict CSP isolation.
- [XEVQOR // HASH](https://xevqor.org/hash/): Browser-native cryptographic digest calculator and file integrity verifier supporting SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and HMAC verification completely offline.
- [XEVQOR // CIPHERLINK](https://xevqor.org/cipherlink/): Create self-contained encrypted payload links where decryption keys remain strictly inside the URL hash fragment (#) and never touch any server.
- [XEVQOR // NANO](https://xevqor.org/nano/): Minimalist client-side encrypted scratchpad and secure note vault operating purely in local browser memory with zero cloud sync or external requests.
- [XEVQOR // NEBULA](https://xevqor.org/nebula/): Encrypt and decrypt sensitive files and binary payloads locally inside your browser using authenticated symmetric cryptography without uploading bytes.
- [XEVQOR // ENCRYPT](https://xevqor.org/encrypt/): Zero-backend encryption and decryption workbench powered by native browser Web Crypto API for confidential text and binary data.
- [XEVQOR // STEGO](https://xevqor.org/stego/): Embed and extract encrypted hidden payloads inside lossless PNG pixel channels directly in browser memory without server-side image processing.
- [XEVQOR // DICE](https://xevqor.org/dice/): Generate high-entropy cryptographic passphrases, hex seeds, and unbiased random numbers using crypto.getRandomValues() completely offline.
- [XEVQOR // QR](https://xevqor.org/qr/): Generate crisp, high-error-correction QR codes for URLs, cryptographic keys, and offline air-gapped transfers without leaking inputs to third-party APIs.
- [XEVQOR // SCRUB](https://xevqor.org/scrub/): Fail-closed binary parser and lossless metadata sanitizer for JPEG, PNG/APNG, PDF, ZIP/Office/ODF, MP4/MOV/M4A, and MP3 with independent post-scrub forensic verification.

## Extended Documentation & Verification
- [Full Technical Architecture & Module Specifications](https://xevqor.org/llms-full.txt): Detailed breakdown of algorithms, binary container parsers, and threat model.
- [Security Policy](https://xevqor.org/SECURITY.md): CSP architecture, cryptographic guarantees, and vulnerability disclosure.
- [Release Checksums](https://xevqor.org/SHA256SUMS.txt): SHA-256 manifest of all static files.
